## Where I stand
Worked out how to pull vendor IDs into the 'Oct AP' sheet: an XLOOKUP on vendor name, which first failed for about half the rows because of invisible characters (trailing and non-breaking spaces, CHAR(160)) in the pasted names. A helper column in 'Vendors' (`=TRIM(SUBSTITUTE(A2,CHAR(160)," "))`) fixed nearly all of it; three name variants remain unmatched. The freeze-top-row question was answered too, and the session ended there.

- [en-cours] three vendor rows still unmatched ('Northpeak Talent Inc.' vs 'Northpeak Talent', 'AWS Marketplace' vs 'Amazon Web Services')
- [prochaine-étape] fix those three IDs by hand in 'Oct AP' column D
- [essai-raté] TRIM over a whole column (`TRIM(Vendors!A:A)`) gave #VALUE; a bounded range or the helper column is needed instead
- [décision] no alias table — the three mismatches get fixed by hand (source: t09)
